#0.51-#0.62: win line when Rider 1 is absent; first speaker = 0.51+k, second speaker = 0.51+k2. Order: Mebius 0, Zero 1, Seven 2, Ultraman 3, OOO 4, W 5, RX 6, Nu 8, Zeta 9, Wing Zero 10, 00 11; Den-O (Momotaros) also uses k=1 (#0.52, 'Yeah, we did it!!' suits both).

#0.79/#0.80 duplicate #0.76/#0.77 for another branch; same English.

Label ??? (CHARA_NAME 30); the event loads the Masurao portrait, so this is Mr. Bushido watching unseen. Label kept as ???.
